dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: About the Mysterious Treasure of the Fontaine Research Institute...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: At the Fontaine Research Institute, they research clockwork and different energy sources, right? So how come there are rumors about a mystery treasure?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: It'd make more sense if the treasure was owned by a bandit or a pirate.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: But Paimon's not sure that the researchers' and technicians' definition of "treasure" is really mysterious enough to get excited about...

choices.text: Hmm... What about "researcher by day, bandit by night"?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Umm... Well for starters, it sounds exhausting. Imagine finishing your day job, then working a whole other job all night... When would they get time to rest?

choices.text: Maybe they wouldn't need to rest...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Ooh! A mystery treasure left by a clockwork meka who's a researcher by day and a bandit by night... Now that sounds more like it!

choices.text: If they were actually a clockwork meka in disguise!
